answer: The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, capped per identity per epoch, no identity may audit its own recruit. The nadir of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Each submission hangs on the atlas of a task receipt, and the knoll is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
